route: direct SSE-listed plain-vanilla public company-bond contractual-cash-flow ladder
why_distinct: The economic hypothesis is contractual coupon, redemption and credit-spread compensation in directly listed public company bonds. It is not a revision of the ETF/fund, direct-equity, REIT, futures-trend, basis or covered-call routes already tested.

source_control_amendment.reason: The R06 independent audit found that the initial preflight retained two SSE rule publication pages but not their linked rule-text attachments. This v2 binds the two first-party attachments in a separate immutable source batch. It changes no route, hypothesis, historical-input assessment, result, suitability inference or action boundary.

bounded_primary_source_findings.finding: Public company bonds listed on SSE are subject to differentiated trading mechanisms and investor-suitability arrangements; issuers must set those arrangements before issuance, and SSE can adjust them as market or credit conditions change.
bounded_primary_source_findings.boundary: This is a venue-rule fact, not evidence that any bond is accessible or suitable on a given date.

bounded_primary_source_findings.finding: SSE distinguishes ordinary and professional investors. Ordinary investors may transact only the listed bond categories stated in the current suitability rule, including eligible public company bonds; access can be restricted after specified adverse-credit or investor-protection events.
bounded_primary_source_findings.boundary: Eligibility must be verified per bond, investor and date through the current broker and venue record; it cannot be inferred from an issuer rating, a bond name or a historical listing alone.

bounded_primary_source_findings.finding: The official bond portal presents bond information, disclosures and quote views, but the captured preflight does not contain a point-in-time historic bond master, complete full-price/turnover tape, coupon/redemption ledger, rating-history file or credit-event history.
bounded_primary_source_findings.boundary: A portal is not a retained, complete backtest dataset.

predeclared_research_hypothesis_not_yet_.selection_calendar: On a fixed annual research date after the ordinary annual-disclosure window, form a point-in-time universe before viewing any subsequent outcome.
provisional_eligibility_filters: RMB-denominated, SSE-listed, publicly issued company bond whose current and historical investor-suitability record explicitly permits ordinary-investor purchase at the relevant test date.

Non-convertible, non-exchangeable, non-perpetual, non-subordinated and plain fixed-coupon with no embedded call or put; no suspended, termination-risk, late-payment, default or unresolved material-credit-event record.
One to three years to stated maturity; complete coupon, redemption, tax and full-price fields; observed trade history and a frozen liquidity threshold.
Issuer financial disclosures and a dated external rating record available before the selection timestamp; one issuer-group cap.
predeclared_research_hypothesis_not_yet_.provisional_construction: Six equal diagnostic sleeves ranked by a predeclared maturity yield measure only after the complete point-in-time universe, price and event records are captured. Fractional sleeves would be calculation labels rather than transaction quantities.
predeclared_research_hypothesis_not_yet_.governance: No historical download, bond selection, parameter search or result calculation is authorized until the universe snapshot, data-source rights, field definitions, no-fill handling, accounting and independent-review protocol are frozen.

missing_blocking_evidence: A retained point-in-time historical master of all SSE public company bonds with listing, delisting, redemption, corporate-action and investor-suitability state for each relevant date.
Per-bond historic full price, accrued-interest convention, trade/turnover observations, trading-status and suspension records with a documented source and timestamps.
Per-bond prospectus terms, coupon and redemption schedule, payment confirmations, tax treatment, issuer-group mapping, rating history, trustee notices and adverse-credit-event timeline.
Dated broker-level records for ordinary-investor access, minimum trading unit, fee, tax, settlement, quote, no-fill and partial-fill treatment without adding personal records to the case.
A frozen point-in-time universe construction, yield calculation, holding/exit, default/restructuring, delinquency, suspension, cost and valuation protocol, followed by independent reconstruction.

strict_screen_boundary.five_percent_role: A future long-run research hurdle only; not a guaranteed annual result, forecast, stable-return claim or action authorization.
strict_screen_boundary.reason: No preserved dataset currently supplies the required historic universe, eligibility, cash-flow, price, liquidity, credit-event and execution inputs.

current_disposition.next_research_gate: Obtain and hash a lawful, retainable point-in-time source package that satisfies every blocking field; otherwise retain not-testable status.
prohibitions: Do not infer ordinary-investor access from a current name, rating or listing status.
Do not treat coupon rate as total return, yield, price or realized result.
Do not substitute an ETF, generic bond index, indicative yield, stale quote or synthetic series for an actual-bond historical record.
Do not select a bond, create an order, claim a return or describe this route as a usable strategy.
